title: Osaka
sideASummary: Player deck back. Dark blue sunburst around a haven on the water. No text and no printed code.
sideBSummary: Osaka, red Player card. Coordinates 34°41'38"N 135°30'8"E. The compass has an anchor, so the city is a port. One covered SEARCH box fills the map. The city name and coordinates repeat upside down along the bottom. Printed code P3-16b.

searchBoxes.effectSummary: Companion Local Resistance. Play this card at any time to remove 1 Hollow Men figure from anywhere on the grid.

states.summary: Same Player back. The SEARCH box is scratched. Companion Local Resistance. Play this card at any time to remove 1 Hollow Men figure from anywhere on the grid.

rules: Red Player card for Osaka. Port: the compass has an anchor.
One SEARCH box. State 2 is that box scratched. Side A stays the Player deck back.
The scratch reveals Companion Local Resistance. Play this card at any time to remove 1 Hollow Men figure from any city on the grid.
Playing the card spends it. The text does not say to destroy it, and it does not say the figure has to be in Osaka.
notes: Card id 10715. State 2 card id 10728. One copy.
Coordinates 34°41'38"N 135°30'8"E. Printed code P3-16b stays on the scratched face.
Goes to the reserve when the package is opened.
The picture is a crowd with raised arms. No door number is printed in the box.
